company_name: Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity supports the semiconductor industry through business attraction and expansion efforts.
summary: The Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity (DCEO) facilitates the growth of the semiconductor industry in Illinois by providing resources such as access to capital, grant opportunities, and site selection assistance. Their collaboration with the Illinois Economic Development Corporation aims to enhance the operational environment for semiconductor manufacturers and related businesses.
capabilities: Access to capital for semiconductor companies
Site selection assistance tailored for semiconductor companies

regional_presence.United States: The DCEO is focused on supporting the semiconductor industry within the state of Illinois.
